# aiwebscan.nl — full agent context

aiwebscan.nl provides technical diagnostics for websites that need to be discoverable, understandable and usable by AI systems and agents. The public scanner does not guarantee ranking, citation, recommendation or compliance.

## Primary service
The scanner accepts a public HTTPS URL and checks selected public resources such as robots.txt, sitemap.xml, HTTP headers, Markdown negotiation, llms.txt, security.txt, JSON-LD, agent discovery files and crawler responses.

## Profiles
- Quick Technical Check
- Complete AI Visibility Audit
- Google AI Search Foundation
- GEO Content & Entity Audit
- Agent & API Readiness
- Commerce & Transaction Readiness
